title: When the Contact Sings
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
